title: gh pr view ${number} --json ${fields} --jq ${filter}
description: One pull request, ${fields} one of title, body, or state,mergeCommit, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:pr-title, forge/github:pr-body, forge/github:pr-state). The types are the PullRequest object of GitHub's GraphQL schema, https://docs.github.com/public/fpt/schema.docs.graphql, as gh renders its fields (https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/api/queries_pr.go): mergeCommit as its oid alone, or null before a merge.
